integrity.literature_boundary: Later operator-weaving work was compared for implication-level overlap, but no claim of exhaustive literature uniqueness is made.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact unilateral-shift counterexample and a direct Hilbert-space analysis-operator estimate.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of all operator tuples preserving wovenness is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The repaired perturbation threshold is sufficient and is not claimed to be necessary or optimal.
The general frame-image characterization by surjectivity is treated as prior theory; originality is restricted to the source-specific theorem correction and quantitative repair.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same source-specific observation.
title: Right invertibility repairs an operator-perturbation theorem for woven frames
